hero.zh: 一次空间扫描，解释完整结构。
hero.en: One spatial scan explains the complete structure.

intro.zh: 首屏只用 3D 解释完整拱形捕获；随后页面回到价格、规格和证据。
intro.en: The hero uses 3D only to explain full-arch capture; pricing, specifications, and evidence then return to ordinary document flow.

title.en: Understand the complete structure in the hero.

body.zh: 连续拱形比一组孤立图片更清楚地解释捕获范围。
body.en: A continuous arch explains capture coverage more clearly than isolated images.

title.zh: 所有购买信息保持普通可读。
title.en: Keep every buying fact ordinarily readable.

body.zh: 扫描范围、精度、时间、兼容性和维护条款都保留在标准文档中。
body.en: Coverage, accuracy, time, compatibility, and service terms remain in a standard document.
